formula_details.weak_form: C=Gamma div_v integral F Fprime U(v-vprime)(grad log F-gradprime log Fprime) d3vprime; U=(I-wwT/|w|²)/|w|.
formula_details.fourth_cumulant: dot kappa_i=Gamma I4_i/2-3 A_i dot A_i; I4_i=E[w_i³ (U A^-1 w)_i].
formula_details.mu_second: mu=m(vx²+vy²)/(2B); dot<mu²>=4a dot A_perp+(2/3)dot kappa_perp for m=B=1.
formula_details.speed_fourth: dot<|v|⁴>=2 tr(A dot A), rather than the Gaussian-closure 4 tr(A dot A).
formula_details.normalization: Gamma_SI=q⁴ lnLambda/(8pi epsilon0² m²); normalized frequency Gamma_SI*n/v0³.
formula_details.rate_matching: alpha=-(dot A_perp-dot A_parallel)/(a-c), nu_L=alpha/3, nu_D=alpha/2; a comparison convention.
